mentions.name: XRoll.io
mentions.description: A fully on-chain gaming framework on the XRP Ledger, inspired by SatoshiDice but built for compliance. It uses commit-reveal fairness (HMAC_SHA256(secret, bet_txn_hash)) with full transparency on-chain, and integrates KYC, AML, and self-limits at the protocol level. The frontend is optional; the ledger is the source of truth.
